page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn7i family. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, with 28 physical cores and hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 346.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.18 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is delivered via a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying on network-attached storage options, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates exceptional capabilities in machine learning and data processing workloads. Its LLM inference performance is highly competitive, achieving top-tier status with 9738.91 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M model and 2464.01 tokens per second on a medium 7B model. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Passmark CPU encryption tests both rank in the top 25%, indicating strong parallel processing and cryptographic performance. The system also registers a strong Passmark database operations score of 22187.83, alongside an average Redis SET throughput of 47.88 million operations per second.

From a resource density and cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of a dedicated 56-vCPU Intel Xeon processor and an enterprise-grade NVIDIA A10 GPU offers a balanced profile for mid-range AI workloads without the premium cost of ultra-high-end accelerator configurations. However, the lack of local NVMe storage represents a key tradeoff, requiring users to architect external storage solutions for data-heavy pipelines. This server is highly suited for workloads such as LLM inference, medium-scale deep learning, video transcoding, database operations, and parallel computing tasks.
